upload_description: This portal handles customer data related to jewelry purchases and inquiries.

templates.prompt: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE contact_city = 'Bengaluru' AND contacts_type = 51 AND is_whatsapp = true AND is_call = true
templates.title: Engaged Bangalore customers
templates.description: Find customers from Bangalore who are engaged via WhatsApp and phone calls

templates.prompt: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE is_starred_lead = true AND is_blocked = false AND is_archive = false ORDER BY last_contact_date DESC
templates.title: Active starred leads
templates.description: Find active customers who have been starred as leads, ordered by most recent contact

templates.prompt: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE contacts_add_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND contacts_type IN (51, 52) AND source IN ('referral', 'organic')
templates.title: New organic and referral customers
templates.description: Find new customers added in the last year who were acquired organically or through referrals

templates.prompt: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE contact_last_product IN ('Gold Ring', 'Kundan Bracelet') AND is_buylead = true AND last_contact_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
templates.title: Gold and Kundan product leads
templates.description: Find customers interested in high-value jewelry products like gold rings and kundan bracelets who have expressed interest in purchasing

templates.prompt: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE contact_state IN ('Karnataka', 'Maharashtra') AND is_archive = true AND is_blocked = false AND is_removed = false AND unread_message_cnt > 0
templates.title: Archived customers with unread messages
templates.description: Find customers in Karnataka and Maharashtra who have been archived but have unread messages, indicating a need for follow-up

templates.prompt: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE contacts_name LIKE '%Sharma%' AND contacts_mobile1 IS NOT NULL AND is_wa_reply = false AND is_call = false
templates.title: Unreached Sharma customers
templates.description: Find customers with the last name Sharma who have not been reached via WhatsApp or phone calls, indicating a need for outreach
